name: Disneyland Royal Street Veranda / Stage Door Sourdough Bread Bowl (Eat Warm Bread, Skip Spicy Gumbo)
brandOrRestaurant: Royal Street Veranda & Harbour Galley (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
searchKeywords: sourdough bread bowl on the side disneyland
whyItWorks: Pro Disneyland hack: at any location that serves Boudin Sourdough Bread Bowls (Harbour Galley, Royal Street Veranda, Pacific Wharf/Aunt Cass), you can ask for the soup "on the side" (or order just the warm Sourdough Bread Bowl!) to get a whole fresh-baked sourdough boule for a few dollars.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Sourdough Bread Bowl with soup on the side so your family can eat the soup while you tear into the warm, un-soaked sourdough bread interior.
watchOuts: Zero triggers in the plain Boudin sourdough bread
